SHOUJOKAGEKIAIJOKAREN-VFX_LEVEL.title: Effect quality
SHOUJOKAGEKIAIJOKAREN-VFX_LEVEL.hover.de: Full: all Karen effects. Low: about one quarter of the particles, decorative redraws capped at 20 fps, reduced ambient glow, wind and ring trails, and text instead of the Last Word video. Off: use base-game attack, buff, card movement, exhaust and energy effects instead of Karen effects; skip the cutscene. Cards, values and controls remain available. Changes apply immediately.
SHOUJOKAGEKIAIJOKAREN-ENABLE_DATA_UPLOAD: Whether to upload the JSON data generated after each run to the statistics server.
SHOUJOKAGEKIAIJOKAREN-SHOW_SPLASH_SCREEN: Show the giraffe splash screen before the MegaCrit logo when the game starts.
SHOUJOKAGEKIAIJOKAREN-GENERATE_MOD_INFO_: This will start exporting the card screenshots and index files required for the mod info HTML. This may take some time. Continue?
